# Setup

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
library(conflicted)
library(readxl)
library(mice)
library(ggmice)
library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)
library(DT)

conflicts_prefer(dplyr::filter,
                 stats::lag)

options(digits = 3)

set.seed(2058)

theme_set(theme_minimal())

weat <- readRDS("intermediate/weat.rds")
dates <- readRDS("intermediate/dates.rds")

show <- vars(!c(lprior, lp__, b_Intercept))
```

## Matrix product backend

Despite setting a seed, imputations with `mice()` from different machines or operating systems might differ slightly, while imputations from the same machine and OS should be fully reproducible. I narrowed this down to different matrix product implementations. To circumvent this problem, the following line sets NETLIB as default matrix backend (default on Windows) if available. Alternatively, use the provided `cwm_itp.rds` file in notebooks following this one.

```{r}
if (.Platform$OS.type == "unix"){
  library(flexiblas)
  if(flexiblas_avail() && "NETLIB" %in% flexiblas_list()){
    flexiblas_switch(flexiblas_load_backend("NETLIB"))
  }
  flexiblas_current_backend()
}
```

## Import trait data

```{r}
traits <- read_xlsx("Data/traits.xlsx", sheet = 1) |> 
  select(species:persistence, la:sm, Fern_Sapro) |>
  #remove height if higher than recorded
  mutate(ph = if_else(ph < 1.5, ph, NA))

datatable(traits)
```

## Import vegetation data

```{r}
#| message: false
data <- read_csv("Data/abundances.csv", trim_ws = T) |>
  #remove bryophythes
  filter(!species %in% c("Atrichum_undulatum", "Hypnum_cupressiforme", 
  "Plagiomnium_affine", "Polytrichum_formosum", "Rhizomnium_punctatum")) |> 
  #use more correct names for the plots
  mutate(plot = recode_values(plot,
                              "ABR01" ~ "01-ABR1",
                              "CAL03" ~ "03-CAL1",
                              "CAM04" ~ "04-CAM1",
                              "VEN20" ~ "20-VEN1",
                              default = plot)) |> 
  #sum covers inside subplots
  group_by(date, plot, species) |> 
  summarise(cover = sum(cover)) |> 
  #convert to proportions
  mutate(cover = cover/sum(cover)) |> 
  ungroup()
```

## Filter plots with missing trait data

Ferns and saprophytes are excluded for some traits: ferns for diaspore mass, saprophytes for height and leaf traits.

```{r}
# leaf traits and height (competition for light) to exclude saprophytes
leaf_height <- c("la", "ln", "sla", "ph")

#tibble to store vegetation, weather data, and models for each trait
cwm <- tibble(trait = traits |> 
                select(!c(species, Fern_Sapro)) |>
                colnames())

#total number of plot-years, same for all traits
plotn <- data |> 
  summarise(n_distinct(date, plot)) |> 
  pull()

#function to filter data for each trait based on cover
traitfilter <- function(trait){
  subtrait <- traits |> 
    select(species, Fern_Sapro, trait = {{trait}}) |>
    drop_na(trait)
  
  subtrait <- if(trait == "sm"){
    #exclude ferns for seed mass
    subtrait |> 
      filter_out(Fern_Sapro == "F")
  } else if(trait %in% leaf_height){
    #exclude saprophytes for leaf and height traits
    subtrait |> 
      filter_out(Fern_Sapro == "Sapro")
  } else subtrait
  
  data |> 
    filter(species %in% subtrait$species) |> 
    group_by(date, plot) |> 
    mutate(tot_cover = sum(cover)) |>
    filter(tot_cover > 0.8) |>
    select(!tot_cover) |> 
    #restore sums to 1
    mutate(cover = cover / sum(cover)) |> 
    ungroup()
}

cwm <- cwm |> 
  mutate(d = map(trait, traitfilter),
         n_left = map_int(d, \(x) x |> 
                        summarise(n_distinct(date, plot)) |>
                        pull()),
         n_removed = plotn - n_left)

datatable(cwm)
```

Which site-years have been removed?

```{r}
cwm |> 
  mutate(removed = map(d,
                       \(x) anti_join(data |>
                                        distinct(date, plot),
                                      x))) |> 
  select(trait, removed) |> 
  unnest(removed) |> 
  datatable()
```

## Empirical CWM

```{r}
#calculate empirical CWM as outcome for imputation
calc_cwm <- function(x, trait){
  traits |> 
    select(species, all_of(trait)) |> 
    right_join(x) |> 
    summarise(cwm = weighted.mean(.data[[trait]], cover, na.rm = T),
              .by = c(date, plot)) |> 
    rename(survey_year = date, site = plot)
}

cwm <- cwm |> 
  mutate(imp = map2(d, trait, calc_cwm))
```

Plot yearly trends in CWM:

```{r}
cwm |> 
  select(trait, imp) |> 
  unnest(imp) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = survey_year, y = cwm, colour = site)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  facet_wrap(vars(trait), scales = "free_y")
```

The large increase in leaf area in 01-ABR1 seems driven by *Rubus caesius*

```{r}
cwm |> 
  filter(trait == "la") |> 
  pluck("d", 1) |> 
  filter(plot == "01-ABR1") |> 
  arrange(desc(cover)) |> 
  left_join(traits |>  select(species, la)) |> 
  datatable()
```

The consistently higher seed mass and SSD in 03-CAL1 seems to be because of *Ruscus aculeatus*

```{r}
cwm |> 
  filter(trait == "sm") |> 
  pluck("d", 1) |> 
  filter(plot == "03-CAL1") |> 
  arrange(desc(cover)) |> 
  left_join(traits |>  select(species, sm)) |> 
  datatable()

cwm |> 
  filter(trait == "ssd") |> 
  pluck("d", 1) |> 
  filter(plot == "03-CAL1") |> 
  arrange(desc(cover)) |> 
  left_join(traits |>  select(species, ssd)) |> 
  datatable()
```

# Imputation

Imputation needs to be done for each trait outcome to be congenial. The considerations about the imputation models and variables are the same as in the "weather" notebook.

```{r}
#remove min and max columns
weat <- weat |> 
  select(!contains(c("min", "max"))) |> 
#remove empty columns
  select(!c(solar_radiation_mean_ITP, wind_speed_mean_ITP)) |> 
#remove wind speed
  select(!wind_speed_mean_OFD)

# identify variable blocks
temp_vars <- colnames(weat)[4:8]

hum_vars <- colnames(weat)[9:12]

#join dates
weat <- weat |> 
  full_join(dates, relationship = "one-to-one")
```

```{r}
#add weather to data
cwm <- cwm |> 
  mutate(imp = map(imp, \(x) weat |> 
                     left_join(x)))

#remove surveys without any weather
cwm <- cwm |> 
  mutate(exclude = map(imp, \(x) x |> 
                     drop_na(survey_year) |>
                     group_by(site, survey_year) |> 
                     summarise(across(air_t_mean_OFD:precipitation_ITP,
                                      \(x) sum(is.na(x))), .groups = "drop") |> 
                     filter(if_all(air_t_mean_OFD:precipitation_ITP, \(x) x == 12)) |> 
                     select(site, survey_year)))

cwm <- cwm |> 
  mutate(imp = map2(imp, exclude, \(x, y) x |> 
                      anti_join(y) |> 
                      mutate(across(c(site, survey_year, year, month), as_factor)))) |> 
  select(!exclude)
```

Setting up `mice`:

```{r}
method <- cwm |> 
  pluck("imp", 1) |> 
  make.method()

method["survey_year"] <- ""

predmat <- cwm |> 
  pluck("imp", 1) |> 
  quickpred(include = c("cwm", "month"), exclude = "survey_year")

#exclude outcomes which are not imputed for clarity
predmat[which(method == ""),] <- 0

plot_pred(predmat, rotate = T)
```

Imputation:

```{r}
cwm <- cwm |> 
  mutate(mice = map(imp, \(x) x |> 
                      mice(predictorMatrix = predmat,
                           method = method,
                           m = 5, maxit = 100,
                           printFlag = F,
                           seed = 19223)))

#complete and keep only data corresponding to surveys

cwm <- cwm |> 
  mutate(complete = map(mice, \(x) x |> 
                          complete(action = "long") |> 
                          semi_join(dates |> 
                                      mutate(across(everything(), as_factor)))))
```

## Imputation diagnostics

Check for NAs, convergence, differences between imputations, imputed against observed data. Since there is heterogeneity in months, the latter is done by month.

```{r}
#plotting functions
#box plot
bwplot_imp <- function(data, vars) {
  map(vars, 
      ~ {
        ggmice(data, aes(x = .imp, y = .data[[.x]])) +
          geom_boxplot() +
          labs(x = "Imputation number")
      }
  ) |> 
    patchwork::wrap_plots()&
    theme(legend.position = "none")
}

#density plot
densplot_imp <- function(data, vars) {
  map(vars, 
      ~ {
        ggmice(data, aes(x = .data[[.x]], group = .imp, size = .where)) +
          geom_density()+
          scale_size_manual(
            values = c("observed" = 1, "imputed" = 0.5),
            guide = "none")+
          facet_wrap(~month,
                     ncol = 3,
                     strip.position = "right",
                     scales = "free_y")+
          theme(strip.text = element_text(size = 8))+
          ggtitle("month")
      }
  ) |> 
    patchwork::wrap_plots(guides = "collect", ncol = 1)&
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")
}

#convergence plot
convplot_imp <- function(data, vars, dia = psrf){
  convergence(data) |> 
    filter_out(is.na({{dia}})) |> 
    ggplot(aes(x = .it, y = {{dia}})) +
    geom_line() +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = 2, alpha = 0.5) +
    facet_wrap(~vrb)
}

# imputed variables 
to_plot <- c("air_t_mean_ITP", "soil_t_mean_ITP", "relative_humidity_mean_ITP", "precipitation_ITP")

cwm |>
  mutate(nas = map(complete, \(t) t |> 
                     summarise(across(everything(), \(x) sum(is.na(x))))), .keep = "none") |> 
  unnest_wider(nas) |> 
  filter(if_any(everything(), \(x) x > 0))
```

```{r}
#| results: 'hide' 
map2(cwm$mice, cwm$trait, \(x, y) plot_trace(x, vrb = !!to_plot) +
              theme(strip.text.y.left = element_text(size = 8, angle = 0)) +
              labs(title = y))

map2(cwm$mice, cwm$trait, \(x, y) convplot_imp(x) +
        labs(title = y))

map2(cwm$mice, cwm$trait, \(x, y) bwplot_imp(x, to_plot) &
       plot_annotation(title = y))
```


```{r}
#| fig-asp: 3
map2(cwm$mice, cwm$trait, \(x, y) densplot_imp(x, to_plot) &
       plot_annotation(title = y))
```

## Preparing data for models

```{r}
#convert mids to list of dataframes, clean columns, calculate annual means
finish_weat <- function(x, veg){
  x |> 
  semi_join(dates |> 
                select(site, survey_year) |> 
                mutate(across(everything(), as_factor))) |> 
    select(!c("month", "year", "cwm")) |>
    #remove OFD used for imputation
    select(!ends_with("OFD")) |> 
    rename_with(\(x) str_remove(x, "_ITP")) |> 
    #calculate 12-month means for each survey
    group_by(site, survey_year) |> 
    summarise(across(everything(), mean), .groups = "drop") |> 
    #precipitation multiplied by 12 because it's an extensive property
    mutate(across(contains("precipitation"), \(x) x * 12)) |> 
    rename(year = survey_year) |> 
    #CAM has no observed ITP data, those should probably not be used in models
    filter_out(site == "04-CAM1") |> 
    #join vegetation data
    inner_join(veg |> 
                 mutate(across(date:species, as_factor)) |> 
                 rename(year = date, site = plot, cov_wt = cover),
               relationship = "one-to-many")
  }

cwm_ITP <- cwm |> 
  mutate(complete = map2(mice, d, \(x, y) complete(x, action = "all") |> 
                         map(\(t) finish_weat(t, y)))) |> 
  select(trait, data = complete)

#join trait values
cwm_ITP <- cwm_ITP |> 
  mutate(data = map2(trait, data,
                     \(x, y) y |> 
                       map(\(t) traits |> 
                       select(species, all_of(x)) |> 
                       right_join(t, by = "species"))))


saveRDS(cwm_ITP, "intermediate/cwm_itp.rds")
```
